description: Header file defining the class e2sm_kpm_du_meas_provider_impl, which implements measurement provider and notifier interfaces for E2SM KPM metrics in a 5G network context. It includes method declarations for metric reporting, support checks, and data retrieval, as well as internal data structures and helper functions.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_du_meas_provider_impl
classes.description: Implements measurement provider and notifier interfaces for E2SM KPM, managing metrics collection, support checks, and data retrieval for network elements.

methods.name: e2sm_kpm_du_meas_provider_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing with UE ID translator and optional max RLC metrics.

methods.name: report_metrics
methods.description: Reports UE metrics or RLC metrics to the system.

methods.name: clear_rlc_metrics
methods.description: Clears stored RLC metrics for disconnected UEs.

methods.name: get_supported_metric_names
methods.description: Returns list of supported metric names at a given level.

methods.name: is_cell_supported
methods.description: Checks if a cell global ID is supported.

methods.name: is_ue_supported
methods.description: Checks if a UE ID is supported.

methods.name: is_test_cond_supported
methods.description: Checks if a test condition type is supported.

methods.name: is_metric_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific metric type and label are supported at a given level and scope.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions
methods.description: Retrieves UEs matching specified test conditions.

methods.name: get_meas_data
methods.description: Retrieves measurement data for specified metrics and UEs.
